footer.disclaimer: Wanderlane is a fictional brand built as a public reference integration for TextSetu. Nothing here is bookable and no payment is ever taken.

ota.explainer: Copy is published from TextSetu and fetched here at runtime, one namespace per screen. Move between tabs and watch each screen fetch its own. "Bundled" everywhere means the CDN could not be reached and the app is serving what it shipped with.

bookings.title: Booking terms
bookings.intro: The terms attached to your current bookings. Nothing here is payable — this is a demonstration app.

policy.title: Cancellation
policy.body: Cancel more than 14 days before arrival and your deposit is refunded in full. Inside 14 days we refund whatever we manage to re-let, and we will tell you either way within two working days.

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: The remaining 80% falls due 14 days before arrival. We will send a reminder seven days beforehand.

taxes.title: Taxes and local charges
taxes.body: Prices include VAT where it applies. City tourist tax is collected at the property and is not included in the total shown.

bookings.note: Every sentence on this screen lives in TextSetu. Change one, publish, and it arrives here on the next load — with no rebuild and no deploy.

schedule.title: What is due, and when
schedule.note: Worked out from the booking, not stored. Nothing on this site is payable.

checkin.title: Arrival
checkin.detail: Youssef will meet you at the derb entrance — the taxi cannot get closer.

dinner.title: Dinner on the roof
dinner.detail: Booked for four. Tell us in advance about anything you do not eat.

bread-oven.title: The neighbourhood bread oven
bread-oven.detail: An early start. Follow the dough from a family kitchen to the communal oven and back.

souks.title: The souks, with Nadia
souks.detail: Three hours, ending at the dyers' quarter.

checkout.title: Departure
checkout.detail: Late checkout is usually possible in November — just ask the night before.

messages.title: Messages

items.welcome: Welcome! I have your dates for November. Let me know roughly what time you land and I will meet you at the derb.
items.arrival-time: We land at 14:20, so probably at the house around four.
items.airport-pickup: Perfect. I will be there from a quarter to four. There is mint tea waiting.

messages.note: Messages are sample content and are not sent anywhere.

composer.label: Reply to your host
composer.placeholder: Ask about the key, the parking, anything.
composer.hint: Nothing is sent. Your text stays in this tab.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Your account, and how this app gets its copy.

language.title: Language
language.body: You are reading this in “{{language}}”. Changing it in the switcher loads that language from the CDN — there is no reload and no deploy.

delivery.title: Content delivery
delivery.offline: No manifest has been read yet, so you are seeing the copy compiled into this build. That is the intended fallback, not an error.

currency.title: Display currency
currency.body: Independent of the language you are reading in. Someone reading in Japanese may still be paying in euros.
currency.note: Presentation only. Nothing is converted here — the same amount is written a different way.
